reviewAdvisory: The supplied figure record for '16 cars' carries no excerpt, and the draft asserts a car-by-car breakdown (11 hard sleeper, 2 deluxe soft, 1 dining) that no supplied figure contains.
The 'Friday afternoon' arrival is not in any supplied figure record, so the draft attributes a schedule detail to the source that the evidence does not carry.
The body and subtitle state the train 'departs Wednesdays at 7:27 am' as settled fact, while the confidence section says the weekday is not stated - the two cannot both be true.
A single one-way fare is not a floor for the overland route; the claim treats an unstated comparison (airfare, visa, meals) as if the figures bounded it.
The draft itself says airfares and flight times are not stated, so asserting the rail option 'competes' is a comparison the figures do not support.
No supplied figure or document supports this statement about China-Russia freight rail; it is outside the evidence and outside the article's priced scope.
